samples.description: Broad USD-denominated, dated-SIC-assigned annual support population for the six 1963–1999 SIC2-by-fiscal-year DA fits; 1962 records supply exact prior-year lags. Rows are retained before model-specific complete-case, minimum-10-group, full-rank, |TA|<=1, performance-matchability, and stratification-availability screens. Fiscal market equity uses dated CRSP common-share prices and shares at the uniquely linked PERMCO; PRCC_F×CSHO is an inferred fallback for FIC=USA, USD-reporting rows only when there is no link or CRSP price/share conflict; unique-LC and no-link routes are counted separately. OCF uses OANCF when available and the documented NI-minus-balance-sheet-accrual proxy otherwise. Final descriptive sample is formed after fitting in Stata. Duplicate GVKEY/FYEAR source rows are audited and resolved by latest DATADATE then PDATE; conflicting top-date/vintage rows stop construction.

assumptions: Jones model: ordinary intercept, 1/lagged AT, ΔSALE/lagged AT, PPENT/lagged AT.
Use OLS by two-digit SIC and fiscal year; the paper says regression/residuals but does not name the estimator.

Use complete cases and at least 10 observations per model-specific SIC/year fit; retain only groups with asreg coefficients present on at least one group row and native Stata e(rank) equal to the expected parameter count. Report any-row/all-row coefficient availability and the native rank distribution by group.

Report Table 1 Panel A on the common post-fit sample: six fitted residual series, four post-fit nearest-ROA matched measures from Jones/modified-Jones equation (6), total accruals, |TA|<=1, all five stratification values, and pooled 1st/99th winsorization.

ROA uses local Compustat NI/AT; market equity uses date-effective CRSP common-share prices and shares at the linked PERMCO, with a documented inferred Compustat fallback; OCF uses OANCF or the supported historical proxy. Characteristic timing/formulas are best-effort and documented in design.md.
Modified Jones is re-estimated with (ΔSALE−ΔRECT)/lagged AT; it does not reuse Jones coefficients.

limitations: Estimator is OLS as a best-effort choice because the paper does not name the regression estimator.

Historical SIC is taken from period-specific Compustat SICH where available, exact-date COMP.CO_INDUSTRY as the next fallback, and uniquely concordant date-effective CCM/CRSP LC P/C SIC followed by lower-confidence LU P/C SIC otherwise; remaining unavailable or ambiguous rows cannot enter a grouped fit.

The paper does not fully specify the exact match/stratification field formulas, timing, nor the winsorization cutoff grouping. Choices are documented and are not tuned to reproduce the published sample size or residual moments.

Local MKVALT is positive only in 1998–1999. Dated CRSP market equity is unavailable when LC links, effective common-share classifications, prices, or shares conflict or are missing. The PRCC_F×CSHO fallback is restricted to FIC=USA, CURCD=USD, and no observed link/CRSP price conflict, with or without a unique LC link; price currency is still inferred. OANCF is absent before 1987, so missing direct observations use NI minus the paper-defined balance-sheet accrual amount as a best-effort OCF proxy.

Performance-matched residuals use nearest neighbors in ROA within two-digit SIC/year, exclude the focal firm, permit control reuse, and resolve equal-distance candidates by sorted ROA/GVKEY order; replacement and exact tie handling are not specified in the paper.

CRSP monthly-price support ends in December 1999; fiscal-year 1999 firm-years with later DATADATE can use only the guarded inferred Compustat price route or have missing MVE, which limits end-of-period size, book-to-market, and earnings-to-price coverage.
